args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson 2.8.0` is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the fixed version in the 2.x line.

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## CI

CI passed on this branch (run `ci-0001`).
